newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher on Telebras gains.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher on Telebras gains.

text.p: Brazil stocks ended up 1.09 percent with Telebras common shares spearheading the rise, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 52 most traded shares ended up 706 points at 65,602 points. Turnover was moderate at 364.9 million reais ($358.1 million).

Traders said investors, some of them foreigners, were buying Telebras common stock to hold in their portfolios. Telebras common accounted for nearly 16 percent of volume against a historic daily average of six percent, traders said.
Telebras common shares closed up 3.26 percent at 66.50 reais.
The rise was also fueled by strong buying in bellwether Telebras preferred shares which ended close to support at 80 reais, analysts said.
Telebras preferred rose 1.75 percent to end at 81.30 reais.
Some analysts said the strong demand for the common share could also be a result of an adjustment to the price of the Telebras preferred share.
Traders expect the bourse to continue rising Friday and keep eyeing Wall Street.

Power state firm Eletrobras preferred share ended flat at 293 reais. Oil monopoly Petrobras preferred shares closed at 121.50 reais, up 0.82 percent. Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce dropped 0.48 percent to end at 20.70 reais.
